text: Naafiqi en no yeloo sinno on yeddayno kon ko Jippinaa e mooɗon wano ɓe yeddiri non, laatoɗon fotooɓe e ngol yeddugol. Wata on jogito immorde e maɓɓe yiɗɓe haa ɓe fera e laawol Alla ngol immo- immorde galle sirku faade ka leydi lislaamu fii felliŋtingol liimanaaku maɓɓe. Si ɓe ɗuurnike gaay ɗum, nanngee ɓe waron ɓe nokku kala ka tawɗon ɓe. Wata on jogito e maɓɓe giɗo, wanaa kadi ko wallindiron e ayɓe mooɗon.
